result.instructions: Tools for PartnerStack, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which partners joined this month, and how many leads did each one submit?"; "Show the leads that are still open and waiting for a decision."; "Which rewards are pending, and for which partners?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes PartnerStack data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run partnerstack_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run partnerstack_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run partnerstack_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. partnerstack_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: partnerstack_list_partnerships
tools.description: List the partnerships of your program: the partners who joined it, with their keys, status and groups. Use it first to find a partnership_key. Returns data.items and data.has_more.

order_by.description: Sort field; a leading - means descending

has_sub_id.description: Only partnerships that use sub IDs (true), do not (false), or are unknown (null)

starting_after.description: Item key: return the items after this one (the last key of the previous page)

ending_before.description: Item key: return the items before this one (use this or starting_after, not both)
